eligible.content: That cloth strip idea is clever—I tried something similar once, but the fabric disintegrated after a couple of days. For your weekend trip, are you using cotton or something more durable? I’m curious if it actually delivers enough water or if the pot still ends up too dry by Sunday.

Oh, nice—synthetic makes sense for durability. I’ve been trying to figure out how to keep my herbs alive on a trip, so this sounds way more reliable than those little water globes. Did you test it with actual plants already, or are you giving it a trial run this weekend?

Totally get that—nothing beats a real test. I’m rooting for it to work out, especially if it means I can stop begging my neighbor to water my thyme. Let me know how it goes Sunday evening, yeah? I’m curious about the before-and-after soil feel.
"I'll definitely let you know how the testing goes when I get my results on Sunday evening—I'll keep you posted!"
